# FlareToolPanelGroup

`Flare.Components.IDE.FlareToolPanelGroup`

Presents several FlareToolPanel children as one tabbed tool area: a tab strip, a single visible panel and the panel bodies kept mounted while hidden. Inside a FlareIdeLayout region the hosted panels still report their titles and modes, so the region rail and auto-hide behavior are unchanged; the group draws the region's collapse button because the individual panel headers are replaced by the tabs.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Kind | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ActiveKey` | `string?` | `` | Parameter |  | Effective key (Key, or the title when that is unset) of the panel to show. Null or empty keeps the group's own selection. A key that matches no panel keeps the current one, so a stale or not-yet-registered key never leaves the body empty. Bind it with ActiveKeyChanged and set it from a host command to select a tool. |
| `ActiveKeyChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports the effective key of the panel the user activated. Bind it to ActiveKey to accept the choice; in controlled mode the group moves only after the parent sets the new key. |
| `ChildContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Tool panels shown as tabs. Every child is a FlareToolPanel; its content stays mounted while another tab is active. |
| `OnActiveChanged` | `EventCallback<string?>` | `` | Callback |  | Reports the title of the panel the user activated, for a status line or command state. Not raised for parameter-driven changes or when the removal of a panel falls back to a neighbour. |
| `Position` | `ToolPanelPosition` | `ToolPanelPosition.Left` | Parameter |  | Region that hosts the group inside a FlareIdeLayout. The hosted panels use this position for rail labels, auto-hide and collapse instead of their own Position. |
| `TabStripPlacement` | `TabStripPlacement` | `TabStripPlacement.Top` | Parameter |  | Which edge carries the tool tab strip. Top keeps the strip in the header above the body, the default and the only placement used before this parameter existed. Bottom renders the strip below the body and shows the active tool's title (and its icon, when set) in the header, so a pinned tool window keeps its name visible while the tabs sit at the bottom edge. |
| `ToolbarContent` | `RenderFragment?` | `` | Parameter |  | Host actions shown in the group header after the tab strip and before the collapse button - for example pin, close or other region commands. Inside a FlareIdeLayout the group still draws the region's collapse button, so the slot adds controls rather than replacing it. |
